content: This information is not intended to replace professional medical advice, nor does it guarantee that a specific product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your individual needs. Always consult your healthcare provider for personalized guidance and complete information about any medication or treatment. Precautions: Before using teduglutide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have any allergies, including to this medication or its ingredients. Some inactive ingredients in this product may cause allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk, so breastfeeding is not recommended while using this product due to potential risks to the infant. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible interactions. Keep a detailed list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory Tests: Medical and laboratory tests, such as colonoscopy, fecal occult blood testing, lipase/amylase levels, and liver function tests, should be conducted before starting this medication and periodically during its use. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is already the next day, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not freeze it or store it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your specific health needs. To view formulary details, create a list of plans, which can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive further details and instructions to access the offer.
